name: Theta-Class Hypergraph
definition: For each $\Theta$-class $E$ of a partial cube $G$, let $C_E$ be the set of all endpoints of edges in $E$. Then $\mathcal H_{\Theta}(G)=(V(G),\{C_E:E\text{ a }\Theta\text{-class}\})$.
comments: Its line graph is the $\Theta$-graph; its 2-section instead has the vertices of $G$ as vertices.
